body.purpose: All human-readable prose: chat messages, empty states, error banners, settings labels. 13px base, 1.5 leading, system-ui stack.

label.purpose: Buttons, badges, tab labels, uppercase section micro-labels. Sans stack at 11px, weight 600.

mono.purpose: File paths, tab labels, line numbers, diff content, the terminal, uppercase section headings (Staged Changes, Turn History), kbd hints. The machine voice — never used for prose.

display.purpose: The first-run screen's headline ('Drive your own coding agent, spec-first') — the only type in the product above the 13px body step. 21px, sans, one step, one place; every other surface stays on body/mono.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: Default for all resting panels, tree/thread/branch rows, tabs, the editor. The workbench is flat-first.

shadows.name: ring
shadows.purpose: The crisp 1px dividing edge, expressed as a ring so it reads as a border rather than a shadow.

shadows.name: raised-light
shadows.purpose: Floating layers: the Modal command-bar (file palette, find-in-files, settings, confirm/rename/branch prompts).

shadows.name: raised-heavy
shadows.purpose: Heavier floating layers: the file-tree context menu.

shadows.name: active-tab
shadows.purpose: The only shadow on a non-overlay element — the active mode-selector button.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The single global focus-visible treatment, applied to every button/input/select and every keyboard-activatable tree/thread/branch row.

motion.name: rail-collapse
motion.purpose: Left/right rail collapse and expand via negative margin — the only layout-affecting transition, deliberately kept to manual toggles rather than continuous drags.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover/background/color state transitions across buttons, rows, and tabs — the vast majority of transitions in the system.

breakpoints.name: no-further-tier
breakpoints.purpose: Rails collapse by sliding fully out of the flex layout (never overlaying the workspace) at any width. Below 760px this is unchanged: the rails don't relayout further — there is no smaller breakpoint tier.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 32px square utility button — every top-chrome toggle (sidebars, theme, terminal, settings, preflight status) and the editor's image zoom controls. Transparent fill, 1px border, 6px radius, muted icon that lifts to foreground on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" type="button" aria-label="Toggle left sidebar"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="14" height="14" fill="none"><rect x="1.5" y="2.5" width="13" height="11" rx="2" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.3"/><rect x="2.5" y="3.5" width="4" height="9" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { min-width: 32px; width: auto; height: 32px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; transition: all 120ms ease-out; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--fg); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent), transparent 55%); } .ds-icon-btn.ok { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-icon-btn.warn { color: var(--warn); border-color: var(--warn); }

components.name: Editor Tab (active)
components.description: The Editor / Console Chat / Code Change Diff tab bar, 28px tall. Active tab lifts to editor-bg with a top-rounded 6px card and a border matching the editor below it; the diff tab additionally tints accent-green when active.
components.css: .ds-editor-tabs { height: 28px; background: var(--chrome-bg); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 0 8px; gap: 2px; } .ds-tab { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; border: none; background: transparent; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--fg); } .ds-tab.active { background: var(--editor-bg); color: var(--fg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom-color: var(--editor-bg); } .ds-tab.diff.active { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Tree / List Row
components.description: The shared interaction contract for file-tree rows, thread-list items, and branch-picker rows: role=button, tabIndex=0, click or Enter/Space to activate, hover/focus lift to surface-warm. The active file-tree row gets an accent-tinted fill; the active thread gets a 2px accent left rail.
components.css: .ds-tree-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 4px 10px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-tree-row:hover, .ds-tree-row:focus-visible { background: var(--surface-warm); } .ds-tree-row.active { background: var(--active-row); color: var(--fg); font-weight: 600; } .ds-tree-row:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent), transparent 55%); }

components.name: Modal (role=dialog)
components.description: The shared wrapper behind the file palette, find-in-files, settings, and every confirm/rename/branch prompt. Blurred-backdrop overlay centered at 18vh; bg-filled command-bar card, 8px radius. Focuses its first control on mount and traps Tab within itself.
components.html: Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
components.css: .ds-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(10, 11, 13, 0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); display: flex; justify-content: center; padding-top: 18vh; } .ds-commandbar { background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; width: min(480px, 90vw); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-commandbar label { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-commandbar input { font-size: 16px; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--fg); outline: none; } .ds-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Diff Line (addition)
components.description: A line inside the Code Change Diff panel or Turn History. 44px right-aligned mono line number in surface-warm, then content. Additions get a 6%-green background and green text with a leading + — color is never the only signal, the leading glyph always carries the same meaning.
components.css: .ds-diff-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-diff-row.add { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--success), transparent 94%); color: var(--success); } .ds-diff-marker { flex-shrink: 0; width: 1ch; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: The h2-level micro-label used for Staged Changes / Changes / Turn History — 11px uppercase mono, muted color, no fill or border. Deliberately not an h4: the app has exactly one h1 (visually hidden, the product name) and every section heading routes through h2, so no level ever gets skipped.
components.css: .ds-section-heading { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Chat Bubble / Spec Mode Banner
components.description: The one surface where the product's original chat-console identity is still visually explicit inside the IDE shell. A twilight-glow gradient banner reading "Spec Mode — read-only planning" appears under the header whenever the active thread is in spec mode. Assistant turns get a 28px twilight-glow avatar; user turns have no avatar or bubble card.
components.html:
Spec Mode — read-only planning
C
Applied the fix directly.
components.css: .ds-spec-banner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--twilight-glow), transparent 80%); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--twilight-glow); } .ds-chat-bubble { display: flex; gap: 10px; max-width: 85%; } .ds-chat-avatar { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--twilight-glow); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--twilight-glow); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Codebase-map (Graphify)
components.description: Force-directed canvas over a surface background. Grab/grabbing cursor, drag to pan, wheel to zoom, double-click to refit. Nodes color by community from a fixed 8-slot CVD-safe categorical palette; anything past slot 8 folds into a neutral 'Other.' The paint loop only runs while the simulation is settling or the view was just touched — it doesn't spin forever once idle.
components.css: .ds-graph-canvas { background: var(--surface); cursor: grab; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-graph-canvas:active { cursor: grabbing; }

components.name: Badges
components.description: Pill-radius, 1px currentColor border, uppercase 11px mono. Text is always present alongside color — never color as the only signal. Used for the spec/go mode badges and the 'new' untracked-file badge.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid currentColor; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-badge.spec { color: var(--accent); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent), transparent 80%); } .ds-badge.new { color: var(--success); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--success), transparent 88%); }

components.name: Database connection row
components.description: A saved database connection in the rail-docked Database panel: name, backend badge, rename/SQL-editor/remove actions on hover. Shares the tree/list row keyboard contract (role="button" tabIndex={0} via Mantine NavLink) and expands into its schema tree on click, same interaction shape as the file tree and thread list.
components.css: .ds-db-conn-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-db-conn-row:hover, .ds-db-conn-row:focus-visible { background: var(--surface-warm); }

components.name: Data grid cell (staged edit)
components.description: An inline-edited table cell before Apply. Left-edge accent inset bar plus a low-opacity accent tint (color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent), transparent 90%) — the same recipe diff-add/diff-remove use, not --twilight-glow, which DESIGN.md scopes to the Spec Mode banner only). A NULL value renders as a dimmed italic ∅ mark, visually distinct from an empty string.
components.css: .ds-db-cell[data-staged] { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--accent), transparent 90%); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); padding-left: 4px; }

components.name: Pending-changes commit bar
components.description: Sticky bar at the bottom of a table tab, shown only while cell edits are staged: row count, Discard / Preview SQL / Apply. Echoes the diff pane's stage/commit strip structurally. Apply always confirms in a Modal (row count + connection name) before running the transaction — the highest-stakes action in the feature, gated like the SQL tab's own destructive-statement confirm.
components.css: .ds-db-commit { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); padding: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }

components.name: SQL editor tab
components.description: Free-form CodeMirror SQL console for one connection, reusing the same on-demand SQL language pack a .sql file gets in the main editor. ⌘↵ runs the statement. A statement matching a destructive shape (DELETE/DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER, or UPDATE/DELETE with no WHERE) is gated behind a confirm Modal that shows the exact SQL text, not generic copy.
components.css: .ds-db-sql { flex-shrink: 0; max-height: 45%; overflow: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }

components.name: Nav Rail Button
components.description: 44px-rail icon button; active state adds active-row fill plus a 2px accent edge bar instead of the plain icon-button hover-only treatment.
components.html: <button class="ds-rail-btn active" aria-label="Specs" aria-pressed="true"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M9 4h6a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v13a1 1 0 0 1-1.5.87L12 18l-3.5 1.87A1 1 0 0 1 7 19V6a2 2 0 0 1 2-2z"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-rail-btn { width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; position: relative; } .ds-rail-btn:hover { color: var(--fg); } .ds-rail-btn.active { color: var(--accent); background: var(--active-row); } .ds-rail-btn.active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 2px; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 1px; }

components.name: Side Panel (head/body)
components.description: Shared wrapper for all eleven NavRail destinations: an 11px uppercase panel-head label over a scrollable body.
components.css: .ds-panel-head { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--muted); padding: 10px 12px 6px; } .ds-panel-body { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 4px 8px; }

narrative.overview:
Palisade Code is a desktop IDE for driving a coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) against a real project — file tree, CodeMirror editor, git diff/staging, a PTY terminal, and a live force-directed map of the codebase, wrapped around an agent chat and diff console. It reads as a serious developer tool first: near-black, dense, monospace-leaning, native macOS window chrome. One color — Dragon Fire Green — cuts through that neutrality to mark whatever is live, active, or agent-touched: the active file-tree row, the active tab, diff additions, the focus ring, the codebase-map's pulse. Everything else stays a disciplined charcoal.

This is the same visual language the product has carried since its chat-console days (--accent, --bg, --surface-warm are unchanged), retargeted at an IDE shell: a three-column workspace (resizable file explorer, tabbed editor/chat/diff center, resizable threads/codebase-map/terminal sidebar) replaced the earlier fixed-width chat cockpit as the product moved from "watch the agent talk" to "work alongside the agent in the same files."
keyCharacteristics: A narrow icon rail gates eleven panels, not a fixed file tree
Two shell arrangements, one DOM (Vibe/Editor preset flip)
Mono for anything machine-shaped, syntax palette included
Command-bar family for every transient surface

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: If it's read as a path, a key, or a label, it's mono; if it's read as a sentence, it's sans. This split predates the IDE pivot and hasn't moved.

rules.name: The No-Skipped-Heading Rule
rules.body: The app has exactly one h1 (visually hidden, the product name); every section heading routes through h2. No heading level is ever skipped, and no bare h4 exists with nothing above it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Dragon Fire Green never appears on borders, dividers, or static chrome — only on something live: an active state, an addition, a focus ring, a link between two files the agent just touched.

rules.name: The Governing Rule
rules.body: Vibe and Editor presets share one panel inventory and differ only in arrangement (flexbox order), never in content — a new panel is added once, not per preset.

dos: Do reserve Dragon Fire Green for live/active/agent-touched surfaces only.
Do set anything path-, key-, or metadata-shaped in the mono stack; prose in the sans stack.
Do collapse the resizable rails by sliding them fully out of the flex layout, never by overlaying the workspace.
Do route every transient prompt (confirm, rename, palette, settings) through the shared Modal component rather than a bespoke overlay div.
Do give every tree/list row real keyboard operability (role=button tabIndex=0 + Enter/Space), not click-only.
Do pair color with a second signal (a glyph, text, an icon) for anything status-bearing — never color alone.
Do keep a new NavRail panel to the shared ds-panel-head/ds-panel-body convention rather than framing it with a bespoke wrapper.
donts: Don't hand-roll a widget Mantine already ships, and don't draw an inline <svg> where a Tabler icon exists — see Components §Implementation stack.
Don't introduce a second brand chromatic color — accent is Dragon Fire Green only; everything else is neutral or semantic status.
Don't shadow a resting panel, row, or tab — shadows are for floating layers and the active mode button only.
Don't use a radius outside the documented five steps (4px, 5-6px, 8px, pill, and the one-off 12px window shell).
Don't rely on placeholder as an input's only accessible name — every primary input carries its own aria-label alongside the placeholder.
Don't add a new var(--r-pill, ...)-style fallback for an undefined variable — reference the pill token directly.
Don't put a heavy, edit-capable surface (a data grid, a big form) inside a NavRail side panel — the panel finds things, a center-workspace tab is where they're worked on.
